vagas.title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em presidente prudente. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring vagas.title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em guarapuava. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

vagas.title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em são carlos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

vagas.title: Product designer
vagas.description:

Buscamos umProduct Designerpara criar experiências digitais simples, intuitivas e agradáveis que ajudem milhares de academias e profissionais do fitness a gerenciar seus negócios com eficiência, reduzindo fricções, acelerando resultados e ampliando o impacto positivo da Next Fit na vida das pessoas.Qual será a sua missão?Criar telas, fluxos e componentes visuais para web e mobile baseados no design system da Next Fit.Garantir consistência, escalabilidade e guidelines claras entre produtos.Transformar requisitos técnicos e de negócio em interfaces intuitivas e agradáveis.Realizar pesquisas com usuários (surveys, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade).Mapear jornadas, criar fluxos, wireframes e protótipos navegáveis.Identificar pontos de fricção e propor melhorias que aumentem retenção, engajamento e “time to value”.Manter, documentar e expandir o design system da Next Fit (componentes, tokens, padrões).Garantir governança e coerência visual nas entregas do time de produto e marketing.Acompanhar KPIs de design (usabilidade, taxa de sucesso, engajamento).Propor testes A/B, medir impacto e iterar rapidamente.Praticar aprendizado contínuo, mantendo-se atualizado em tendências de UI/UX Saa S.Trabalhar próximo ao time de Produto, Engenharia, Marketing e CS na definição de funcionalidades.Participar de rituais ágeis (planning, refinamento, review).Competências mínimas:Experiência comprovada em UI/UX/ Product Designer (mínimo 1 ano atuando em produto digital).Domínio de Figma (componentes, autolayout, prototipação, libraries).Vivência com pesquisa de usuários, testes de usabilidade e heurísticas.Capacidade forte de criar interfaces limpas, funcionais e responsivas.O que oferecemos:Vale Alimentação (R$750,00) - vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Strategic partnership & alliance em sapiranga. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystemCollaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreementsRepresent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutionsMonitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenueProvide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work ExperienceBachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystemKnowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targetsEntrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovationCulturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

vagas.title: Strategic partnership & alliance
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Strategic partnership & alliance em sorocaba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystemCollaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreementsRepresent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutionsMonitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenueProvide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work ExperienceBachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field5+ years of experience in Company DescriptionBrooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.Role DescriptionWe are seeking a detail-oriented and organizedFamily-Based Immigration Paralegalto join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.Key ResponsibilitiesPrepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documentsCollect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracyMaintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-upsCommunicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiriesAssist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidanceDraft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materialsMonitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulationsHandle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalismQualificationsPrior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based casesStrong working knowledge of USCIS forms and proceduresExcellent organizational and time-management skillsStrong written and verbal communication abilitiesAbility to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environmentBilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only﻿To ApplyTo be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!You be your own boss and set your own scheduleWork from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.C1 or C2 Level English SpeakerUniversity degree in English Teaching or related area.One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.Must pass a criminal background check.Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)Location: LATAMDuration: 6-12monthsJob Summary:We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.Key Responsibilities:·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows.·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation.·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams.·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization.Required Qualifications:·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure.·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud.·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management.·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration.

Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)Location: LATAMDuration: 6-12monthsJob Summary:We are looking for aSalesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. QualificationsExperience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.Familiarity global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & MissionOSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Emerging market trader em americana. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key ResponsibilitiesFX Trading & Liquidity ManagementManage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk ManagementDesign and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & SystemsWork closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:Automated hedging enginesLiquidity aggregation systemsSmart order routingPricing and risk management toolsIntegrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.Market DevelopmentIdentify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.RequirementsExperience5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGPLATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARSExperience working at:Global banksEM FX trading firmsPayment / fintech companiesCrypto exchanges or market makersProven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.Technical ExpertiseDeep understanding of:FX market microstructure in illiquid marketsNDF markets and offshore hedgingCapital controls and FX regulatory frameworksHands-on experience building or optimizing:FX trading systemsHedging enginesLiquidity aggregation platformsFamiliarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.SkillsStrong quantitative and analytical capabilities.Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred QualificationsExperience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.Strong analytical and problem solving skillsAbility to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & MissionOSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

vagas.title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em quatro barras. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em indaial. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

vagas.title: Coordenador comercial
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Coordenador comercial em florianópolis. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Descrição da EmpresaA Salus Brand é uma empresa inovadora e comprometida com a excelência em soluções e serviços de qualidade. Reconhecida por sua atuação no mercado e foco no cliente, valorizamos a colaboração, a inovação e o desenvolvimento contínuo. Nosso objetivo é oferecer um ambiente dinâmico onde profissionais talentosos possam crescer e contribuir para o sucesso da empresa. Trabalhamos para criar impacto positivo em nossos clientes e parceiros, promovendo relações de confiança e resultados consistentes.Descrição do CargoEstamos em busca de um Coordenador Comercial para integrar nossa equipe em Blumenau, SC. Este profissional será responsável pela gestão das operações comerciais, elaborando e implementando estratégias de vendas, acompanhando indicadores, liderando equipes e garantindo o atingimento das metas institucionais. A rotina diária envolverá atividades como prospecção e manutenção de clientes, análise de métricas de vendas e capacitação da equipe. Este é um cargo de tempo integral com atividades presenciais.QualificaçõesGestão e liderança:Experiência em gestão comercial, gestão de equipes e liderança estratégica para alcance de metas organizacionais.Relacionamento e acompanhamento:Capacidade para acompanhar clientes e prospects, promovendo uma comunicação clara e eficiente.Habilidades analíticas:Visão estratégica apoiada por forte capacidade de análise de dados e indicadores de desempenho comercial.Além das competências listadas, é desejável ter experiência com ferramentas de CRM, habilidades em negociação e formação na área de administração, gestão comercial ou correlatas.

We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Company DescriptionBrooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.Role DescriptionWe are seeking a detail-oriented and organizedFamily-Based Immigration Paralegalto join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.Key ResponsibilitiesPrepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documentsCollect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracyMaintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-upsCommunicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiriesAssist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidanceDraft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materialsMonitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs)Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulationsHandle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalismQualificationsPrior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based casesStrong working knowledge of USCIS forms and proceduresExcellent organizational and time-management skillsStrong written and verbal communication abilitiesAbility to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environmentBilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only﻿To ApplyTo be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.ResponsibilitiesLead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.QualificationsAt least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Strategic partnership & alliance em gravataí. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:BrazilType:Full-Time ContractSetup:Fully RemoteLevel:Mid-LevelIndustry:Software SAAS CompanyShift:US HoursStart Date:can start in 2 weeks after offerEquipment:Available upon requestRate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical GroupThe Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the OpportunityOur client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.ResponsibilitiesLead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.QualificationsAt least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

DescriçãoO Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. negociações estratégicas;Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, Confira a vaga para Strategic partnership & alliance em sapucaia do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystemCollaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreementsRepresent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutionsMonitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenueProvide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work ExperienceBachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystemKnowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targetsEntrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovationCulturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Strategic partnership & alliance em guaíba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystemKnowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment
